title: Turmeric Curcumin Formula | Doral, Florida – Luminex Wellness Shop
abstract:
# Turmeric Curcumin Formula  
A clinically studied turmeric extract featuring BCM-95®, a patented form of curcumin with 7× greater bioavailability. Delivers powerful antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cellular protection to support joints, brain, mood, and immune balance.  
60 Capsules  
Take one (1) capsule twice daily, or as directed by your healthcare practitioner. Cautions: Consult your healthcare practitioner before use, especially if taking medication (e.g., blood thinners or chemotherapy). Do not use if tamper seal is damaged. Best taken with food to enhance absorption and reduce GI discomfort.  
Luminex **Turmeric Curcumin Formula** is a powerful antioxidant and anti-inflammatory supplement featuring **BCM-95®**, a **100% pure turmeric extract** standardized to curcuminoids and essential oils from the turmeric rhizome (*Curcuma longa*).  
BCM-95® is clinically shown to deliver **6–7× greater absorption** than standard curcumin, ensuring enhanced bioavailability and longer retention in the bloodstream.* This unique formula combines curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin with naturally occurring essential oils — including ar-turmerone and α-/β-turmerone — to replicate the full-spectrum synergy of raw turmeric.
Unlike other bioenhanced formulas, BCM-95® contains **no phospholipids, piperine, carriers, or synthetic additives**, making it a pure and natural option for supporting **joint comfort, brain function, mood balance, immune modulation, and healthy inflammation response**.

- **Promotes Antioxidant & Cell Protection**– Neutralizes free radicals and supports healthy cellular repair.
- **Supports Joint Comfort & Flexibility**– Helps relieve minor pain and stiffness associated with physical activity.
- **Enhances Mood & Cognitive Function**– Supports brain health, focus, and emotional balance through neuroprotective activity.
- **Encourages Healthy Inflammatory Response**– Modulates cytokine production and signaling pathways involved in inflammation.
- **Supports Healthy Cell Growth**– Promotes cellular balance and inhibits abnormal cell proliferation in certain cell lines.
- **Improves Gut & Immune Health**– Supports a balanced microbial environment and overall immune defense.
